title: Zephyr: Chat encode/decode
notes: Implemented isolated Zephyr Compact CoT chat codec with independent Kconfig/CMake selection, preserving the PLI codec. Owned fixed-capacity message structure supports broadcast/team/direct destinations and 0..255 UTF-8 bytes without allocation; encoder returns the exact 3..274 byte size. Both directions are atomic and overlap-safe. Decoder rejects non-chat subtypes, destination types outside 0..2, team IDs outside 1..10, truncated headers/address/message, trailing bytes, and malformed RFC 3629 UTF-8 (overlongs, surrogates, out-of-range code points, bad/truncated continuations). Focused host C strict-warning/UBSan CTest passed 1/1 across all 9 positive canonical chat vectors, 7 negative vectors, max length, NULL, short-buffer, reserved, UTF-8, and overlap cases. cppcheck C11 and diff-check passed; PLI C regression 1/1; Python Compact CoT 87/87; Rust canonical vectors 4/4.
